usage: The word '翅' refers to 'wing' and is usually a noun.
It is often used to describe the wings of birds, insects, or flying animals.
'翅' can be used on its own or as part of compound words.
When describing possession, it can be combined with a possessive particle, e.g., '隻鳥嘅翅'.
It's a countable noun, so you can say '一對翅' to mean 'a pair of wings'.
